material_amplitude_calibration.fit_rule: scale each seed-median model field to frozen nominal specific-wear target; no DEC score feedback

baseline_worn_reference.baseline: official face-domain geometry only; zero wear field
baseline_worn_reference.worn: geometry-only participant depth field with literature regional weights
baseline_worn_reference.shape_rule: literature region weight x lateral centrality x longitudinal flow factor, restricted to fixed 99th-percentile geometry-only hotspot core; depth scale is area-integrated to target material volume

axis_metadata.normalization: principal-coordinate min-max over official face centers

baseline_worn_reference.independence: does not read any model erosion field
baseline_worn_reference.claim_boundary: participant-built baseline/worn reference; not measured surface truth

model_combination.combination: fixed weighted arithmetic mean of material-calibrated seed-median fields

score_detail.aggregation: median across four held-out model scores; seed scores retained as independent diagnostics

claim_scope: conditional competition score using participant-built baseline/worn field and participant DEC face mapping; not official or measured truth
limitations: No laboratory baseline/worn scan was supplied; synthetic participant field remains the reference source.
No measured ZG0Cr13Ni4Mo batch was supplied; material calibration is prior-based.
PCA region labels are participant assumptions and require reproducible geometry review.
The official gates remain unchanged and cannot be inferred from the competition self-benchmark.
